Plinth, a space for drawing, sound and slow objects Open Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00 to 18:00

Six rooms.One longlook.

Plinth keeps three exhibitions open at once and changes one of them every eight weeks. Nothing is hung in a hurry, and nothing travels far. The programme is built around what a room can hold and how long a person is willing to stand still.

See the whole programme

Six rooms and a courtyard, on one floor, at the end of an example street.

Access, the courtyard and the floor plan

The building is one floor around a courtyard. Rooms 1, 2 and 3 run along the north side, the upper hall and the study room sit behind the stairs, and the courtyard stays open in all weather. A visit takes about forty minutes if you stop in every room.

Talks happen in the study room on the first Thursday of the month. Ask at the desk, or write to the programme office and someone will answer within a few days.
